drivingQuestion: How does one who is impure or standing in unfit water complete his prayer and his recitation of Shema without interrupting?
outcomeNote: A mishna stating rulings; it contains one internal question-and-answer and no dispute between named tannaim.

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הָיָה עוֹמֵד בִּתְפִלָּה וְנִזְכַּר שֶׁהוּא בַּעַל קֶרִי, לֹא יַפְסִיק, אֶלָּא יְקַצֵּר.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» This mishna contains various statements with regard to individuals with different types of ritual impurity as well as the need to distance oneself from filth and impurity. «One who was standing in prayer and he recalled that he experienced a seminal emission,» and according to this opinion he is prohibited from praying, should «not interrupt» his prayer, «rather he should abridge» each individual blessing.

segments.he: יָרַד לִטְבּוֹל, אִם יָכוֹל לַעֲלוֹת וּלְהִתְכַּסּוֹת וְלִקְרוֹת עַד שֶׁלֹּא תְּהֵא הָנֵץ הַחַמָּה — יַעֲלֶה וְיִתְכַּסֶּה וְיִקְרָא, וְאִם לָאו — יִתְכַּסֶּה בְּמַיִם וְיִקְרָא. וְלֹא יִתְכַּסֶּה לֹא בַּמַּיִם הָרָעִים וְלֹא בְּמֵי הַמִּשְׁרָה, עַד שֶׁיָּטִיל לְתוֹכָן מַיִם. וְכַמָּה יַרְחִיק מֵהֶן וּמִן הַצּוֹאָה — אַרְבַּע אַמּוֹת.
segments.en: They stated a general principle: «One who descended to immerse himself, if he is able to ascend, cover himself» with a garment, «and recite» the morning Shema «before sunrise, he should ascend, cover himself, and recite» Shema, «and if not,» he should «cover himself in the water and recite» Shema there. «He may not, however, cover himself in either foul water, or water» in which flax was «soaked, until he pours» other «water into it. And» in general, «how far must one distance» himself «from» urine «and feces» in order to recite Shema? At least «four cubits.»

moves.cueHe: היה עומד בתפלה ונזכר שהוא בעל קרי
moves.summary: One who recalls mid-prayer that he experienced an emission does not interrupt but abridges.
One immersing before sunrise emerges and covers himself to recite if time allows; if not, he recites covered by the water.
moves.about: how far one must distance himself from foul water and from feces before reciting

moves.cueHe: ולא יתכסה לא במים הרעים ולא במי המשרה
moves.summary: Foul water and flax-soaking water do not serve as his covering until other water is poured in.
The mishna asks the measure of the required distance from such water and from filth.

edges.about: how far one must distance himself from foul water and from feces before reciting
